limitations: I authored bounded preflight changes to the harness, tests and mixed-case criterion clarification before freeze. This is an unblinded author/counterpart assessment, not external independent validation. I assessed the results without receiving the concurrent Claude semantic conclusions.
Five author-created synthetic cases, one native client/responding model, one one-shot session per case; no baseline comparison, general reliability estimate or comparative benefit claim follows.

Explicit Skill invocation, six exposed tools and a restrictive project/write guard limit transfer to unrestricted or implicitly selected skill use. Requested High effort is not independently observed in subject output.

Review uses the frozen manifest, normalized exported final files/final messages and relevant trajectory, plus the frozen protocol; it is not a fresh execution or a full system-prompt/host-isolation audit. Raw Skill output and startup inventories are intentionally not exported.

Positive artifact outcomes do not generally establish voluntary restraint; in this run the explicit attempt records contain no denied writes, and the audit contains no write/search attempts. These bounded observations should remain separate from broader reliability claims.
No subject files were edited, sessions retried, criteria changed or previous studies rescored during this assessment.
